dialog.edotensei.hashirama: A village is a place where people protect one another.
dialog.edotensei.tobirama: A shinobi must always be prepared.
dialog.edotensei.hiruzen: The Will of Fire still burns in this village.
jutsu.edotensei.shiki_fujin.desc: Kills the target in your sights. Costs almost all of your life.
jutsu.edotensei.edo_tensei.desc: Gives you the Edo Tensei Scroll to resurrect a Hokage.
message.edotensei.already_have: You already have this jutsu item.
message.edotensei.not_learned: You have not learned the Edo Tensei.
message.edotensei.already_drained: This body has already been drained of blood.
message.edotensei.sealed: The creature is sealed in place.
message.edotensei.scroll_empty: The scroll is empty. Use a syringe with blood.
message.edotensei.target_not_aligned: The scroll is not pointing at your sealed creature.
dialog.edotensei.madara: Wake up... and see what true power is.
dialog.edotensei.shisui: Protecting the village is what matters. Don't make me fight.
message.edotensei.teach.too_far: Get closer to %s to learn this.
message.edotensei.teach.unavailable: Could not learn: Narutoto has no such power registered.
